what: Hovering a menu or footer link tints the letters in the accent color from the front at .03s intervals (.5s power1.out per letter), and on release they return to their own color in the same order — while hovered they stay tinted

options.--fx-tint: Tint color (via style or css), default --kf-accent
options.[data-fx-part=text]: (optional) text to split — if none, the element’s own text

from.where: shared.js footer links · menu panel links (original handleHoverAnimation — SplitType chars, mouseenter gsap.to(color #6295ff, stagger .03) · mouseleave color '' Same order)
